parts.part: The claim comes from Artemis R-13 (#889 routing)

notes: Terminology caveat: in a17.py the per-candidate flag ACCEPTED_CANDIDATE (a17.py:269) marks a qualifying draw. The per_stratum 'accepted' count, which is what the report prints, is the capped admission count. The claim is about the report's 'accepted/evaluated' figure and holds. Catalog B add has 5 qualifying of 22 evaluated but reports 4/22. The evidence lives on Aphrodite seat-branch commits (373d7ef28, ac2a935db, 4f937e88f), not on main. I read it with git show. I could not run Python, so I counted with grep on the evals JSONL.
